problem.headline: The job gets finished. The marketing usually dies there.
problem.subheadline: Photos sit in the camera roll. The website stays stale. Google stays quiet. The review never gets asked.

pain_points.title: Proof stays on phones
pain_points.body: Homeowners never see the work you already finished in their neighborhood.

pain_points.title: Google goes quiet
pain_points.body: No fresh job activity means your profile looks inactive next to competitors.

pain_points.title: Reviews slip away
pain_points.body: The ask happens late — or never — while the next truck wins the five-star.

problem.closing: Without JCP: job finished → forgotten. With JCP: job finished → proof created → published → reused.

faq.headline: Straight answers before you start the demo

items.q: Do my technicians need to write marketing content?
items.a: No. They capture the job like they already do. JobCapturePro builds the usable proof from the photo, job, and location data.
No. JobCapturePro is the proof and marketing layer. It can sit alongside the tools you already use.
No. Rankings depend on many factors. JCP helps you publish consistent real-job proof that can support local visibility — it does not promise ranking outcomes.

items.q: Will this add work for my crew?
items.a: The field workflow stays light: take the photo (and show a QR for reviews when you use that flow). The system handles the downstream content.

items.q: What do I need for the demo?
items.a: A trade, work email, and mobile number are enough to personalize the experience. No credit card.
